authorization: User accepted annual-only/ST-only simplification and removed the 5,000-observation target.
target: New ST or *ST implementation in [May 1 Y, May 1 Y+1), among eligible non-ST firms at origin. This is not all-cause financial distress.
exclude_baseline: ST/*ST only; no quarterly-loss or audit-loss exclusion in the redesigned target.
ratio_note: All stock denominators are explicitly year-end balances; these are not average-balance ROA/ROE. No prior-year balance, share-count proxy, capex or expensed-interest input is required.

text.source: MD&A of the same preorigin annual report
text.representation: training-only character TF-IDF and truncated SVD on bounded text chunks
text.fit_scope: training documents only; identical fitted representation for every variant

model.attention: Financial representation queries multiple text chunks; padding masked; no singleton-key degeneration.
model.loss: binary cross entropy; any class weighting estimated from training only

evaluation.primary: test average precision and paired difference, with company-cluster bootstrap intervals
evaluation.threshold: Select once on validation for each model/seed; never select on test
evaluation.unit: firm clusters retaining repeated company-year records
evaluation.adequacy: No arbitrary total-N target. Report event counts and distinct event firms in every split, interval widths and variability across seeds. If event counts or intervals cannot resolve an improvement, report inconclusive evidence; do not expand/stop the sample by test performance.
evaluation.claims: Predictive association, not causality, universal distress or guaranteed early warning.

sampling.rule: Complete the fixed reduced source frame; no outcome-dependent replacements or exact-count quota.
